units: <cite ref="Menachot 38b:9">Men. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>איג׳ תכלת וכ׳</he> if the blue fringe has been lopped off, but the white remains &c.
Ib. 39ᵃ גרדומין דאִיגַּרְדּוּם אִיגַּרְדּוּמֵי does not gardumav intimate that they (the fringes) are entirely cut off (leaving no remnant)?
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 39:12">Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 12</cite> <he>היך עמר דאית׳</he> (Ms. <he>דאיג׳</he>) like wool nibbled at (by moths; h. text <he>כָּעָשׁ</he>).
